text:
Which statement about identical lamps in a parallel circuit is not correct?
A
If one lamp blows, the others remain switched on.
B
The current in each lamp is different.
C
The lamps can be switched on and off separately.
D
The lamps have the same voltage across each of them.

options.label: A
options.text: If one lamp blows, the others remain switched on.

options.label: B
options.text: The current in each lamp is different.

options.label: C
options.text: The lamps can be switched on and off separately.

options.label: D
options.text: The lamps have the same voltage across each of them.
